SYK_2010_p66__paragraph_4.ocr:
Deferred income taxes reflect the net income tax effects of temporary differences between the carrying
amounts of assets and liabilities for financial reporting purposes and the amounts used for income tax purposes.
Valuation allowances are recorded to reduce deferred income tax assets when it is more likely than not that an
income tax benefit will not be realized.
